correctness.rationale: At rho=sqrt(a12 a21)=1+tx/ty<1+b, the exactly active four-dimensional linearization splits into exponentially stable (P,Q) and harmonic (U,V) sectors. The quadratic action I=(U−V)^2+(κ²−1)V² is conserved on the jointly active center plane; Lc=min(h1/√a12,h2/√a21)>0 is first grazing amplitude. ReLU clipping gives explicit signed center forcing; at a grazing extremum κ²V−U=0 and U=±Lc so action loss has strictly negative leading sign. The negative-potential excursion integral is (4√2√a_ij/(3ω√Lc))δ^{3/2}, with m=1 or 2 independent grazing times; converting ΔI to ΔL gives C=2√2 m rho/(3txω√Lc). Stable-sector variation of constants yields O(δ^{3/2}) per cycle and the local forward-invariant cone ||(P,Q)||≤K δ^{3/2} with a contractive stable return block; perturbation of clipping integrals is O(δ²). Thus 0<δ_{k+1}=δ_k−Cδ_k^{3/2}+O(δ_k²)<δ_k and δ_k^{-1/2}/k→C/2 by telescoping/Cesàro; stable section coordinates are O(k^{-3}). Independently recomputed symbolic action conservation, leading parabolic integral and m=1/2 theoretical constants 5.0082706562 and 8.3730811151. The local return uniformity argument is sketch-level and a residual analytic regularity risk, not replaced by finite integrations.
